QUOTE: Rebuilding is unsafe here, not just ineffective. A stale process running an old pipeline would re-stamp the index with dropped layers. `build_or_refresh` refuses before the lock when the process predates its source, and `force` cannot override that.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer covers the build-side risk of a stale process writing old pipeline logic, but never says reads stay current because query tools open the database per call, so the read/write asymmetry is missing.
